arm9.evidence: ARM9 re-hashes snapshot files from disk and compares copy bytes to source_pre_raw, not to manifest copy_raw; this is independent of the copy_raw field.
arm9.limit: The arm does not tamper with a copy after manifest creation, and its absolute JEV_STATUS/JEV_SIDECAR fixture form can map to itself, so it does not fully prove private-copy fidelity.

force_moved.evidence: JEV_FORCE_MOVED unions a path into moved, causing recapture then rc10 on attempt 2; it cannot create a PASS.
force_moved.risk: It can suppress a real durable RED into TRANSIENT_UNSTABLE when the test hook is present, so the hook must be test-only and never operator-provided in production.

identical_digest_line.evidence: Output can say moved: path c160... -> c160...; equal hashes show classification was forced only to someone who knows the hook.
identical_digest_line.repair: Print forced=true/reason=test-hook or a separate forced_paths field; do not make readers infer from equal hashes.

no_verdict.evidence: _verify report is returned but not printed until after movement check; unstable path prints TRANSIENT_UNSTABLE/NO VERDICT only.

overall: ARM suite proves bounded transient control and manifest self-digest/copy checks, but ARM9 scope and forced-movement disclosure remain bounded findings.
